name: com.mcp-elementor/elementor-mcp
title: Elementor MCP Créateur (third-party plugin)
description: Mockup to native, editable Elementor page from claude.ai or ChatGPT: design tokens, SEO, Schema.org.

site_domain.description: Domain of the WordPress site where the plugin is installed, without https:// (e.g. example.com)

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional. Leave empty for OAuth 2.1 sign-in (claude.ai, ChatGPT, Claude Desktop): log in to WordPress and approve. Clients without OAuth: Basic base64(MCP_ELEMENTOR:application-password), from WP admin > Elementor MCP > Configuration MCP.
